text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and track their progress. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points along the project timeline, and deliverables, the final products or results you promise to provide. Finally, making sure all stakeholders agree on these goals is vital. When everyone shares the same understanding from the start, the project is much more likely to succeed.
